climate-security-2021-12-13.chair-received: Russia opposed an automatic climate-security link, preferring UNFCCC work and a Sahel-specific draft. India opposed moving climate decisions to the Security Council, supporting a draft limited to the Sahel. Both delegations favored a Sahel-focused alternative and opposed expanding the Security Council's climate authority.
